decisions.reason: As a multi-model executive desk system tightly aligned with the firm's office and conference competencies, its continued place in the range suggests sufficient revealed value to keep this option active.

Although it remains the weakest of the surviving 2018 launches because it was less prominently positioned and faces many nearby substitutes, it is still close to the core lounge offering and not yet weak enough to justify abandonment.
The high standing table fits the firm's direction toward flexible contemporary workplaces, and after several years on the market it still looks like a sensible adjacent product to retain.
